```{r}
devtools::load_all();
```

## Input specifications for selectivity and retention functions and parameters

Specifying selectivity and retention functions consists of three steps: 

  1. specify function types
  2. specify parameter values
  3. specify functions as a combination of function types and parameter values

Functions types provide a shorthand for matching parameters with `rtmbGMACS` functions to define the actual model selectivity/retention functions. This (seemingly somewhat complicated) approach to specifying model selectivity/retention functions and their parameters is necessary to allow parameters to be shared between functions.

### Function types 

Function types are defined in rows in a "Function type table", which has the following columns: 

  * tid -  a unique integer id used as a shorthand to refer to a specific function type
  * function - function name (the name of the `rtmbGMACS` function to use)
  * type - "sel" or "ret" to specify whether the function reflects selectivity or retention, respectively 
  * label - character string with underscores representing spaces to be used as a label


#### Example 

The following code creates a table of function types for capture selectivity and retention in the directed Tanner crab fishery ("TCF") and capture selectivity of Tanner crab in the snow crab fishery (SCF). Five function types are created below to allow distinguishing labels to be applied to each, although only three (with different labels, of course) are really needed (1, 2, and 4) because 1 and 3 specify the same function to be used for selectivity and 4 and 5 specify the same function to be used for retention.

```{r}
##--fishery selectivity and retention functions
str = paste0("
tid  function      type  label
1   sel_logistic    sel  TCF_selectivity
2   sel_dbl_normal3 sel  SCF_male_selectivity
3   sel_logistic    sel  SCF_female_selectivity
4   sel_logistic    ret  TCF_male_retention_(start-2004)
5   sel_logistic    ret  TCF_male_retention_(2005-end)
")
tblSelFcns = readr::read_csv(str |> whitespace_groups_to_commas(),progress=FALSE,show_col_types=FALSE)
cap = "tblSelFcns, a `tibble` describing the types of selectivity and retention functions used in the model."
kableExtra::kbl(tblSelFcns,booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
```


### Parameters 

Parameters are defined independently of the functions to which they might apply.

```{r}
##--set up model dimensions
dim_y = num_to_factor(1948:2025);
dim_s = num_to_factor(1:7);
dim_f = text_to_factor(c("TCF","SCF")); 
dim_x = text_to_factor(c("M","F"));
dim_m = text_to_factor(c("imm","mat"));
dim_c = text_to_factor(c("ns","os"));
dim_zc = seq(25,185,5); #--size cutpoints
dim_zb = calcBinCenters(dim_zc);
dimsYS = tidyr::expand_grid(y=dim_y,s=dim_s);
dimsF  = tidyr::expand_grid(f=dim_f);
dimsPD = tidyr::expand_grid(x=dim_x,m=dim_m,c=dim_c,z=dim_zb);
```

```{r}
##--set up various model frames for assigning parameter values and functions
lstMFs = list();
###--for TCF
lstMFs$tblFs_TCF = dimsF |> dplyr::filter(f=="TCF");
lstMFs$tblYS_TCF = dplyr::bind_rows(
                    tibble::tibble(y=1948:1980,s=3,tb=1), #--time block 1
                    tibble::tibble(y=1981:1990,s=3,tb=2), #--time block 2
                    tibble::tibble(y=1991:2025,s=3,tb=3)  #--time block 3
                   ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb=factor(tb));
lstMFs$tblYS_retZ1 = dplyr::bind_rows(
                      tibble::tibble(y=1948:1980,s=3,tb=1), #--time block 1
                      tibble::tibble(y=1991:2025,s=3,tb=3)  #--time block 3
                     ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb=factor(tb));
lstMFs$tblYS_retZ2 = dplyr::bind_rows(
                       tibble::tibble(y=1981:1990,s=3,tb=2) #--time block 2
                     ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb=factor(tb));
lstMFs$tblYS_retW1 = dplyr::bind_rows(
                       tibble::tibble(y=1948:1990,s=3,tb=1), #--time block 1
                       tibble::tibble(y=1991:2025,s=3,tb=2)  #--time block 2
                     ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb=factor(tb));
cap = "Head of tblYS_TCF, a model frame describing time blocks related to TCF."
kableExtra::kbl(lstMFs$tblYS_TCF |> head(),booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);

###--for SCF
lstMFs$tblFs_SCF = dimsF |> dplyr::filter(f=="SCF");
lstMFs$tblYS_SCF = dplyr::bind_rows(
                    tibble::tibble(y=1948:1990,s=3,tb=1), #--time block 1
                    tibble::tibble(y=1991:1996,s=3,tb=2), #--time block 2
                    tibble::tibble(y=1996:2025,s=3,tb=3)  #--time block 3
                   ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb=factor(tb));
cap = "Head of tblYS_SCF, a model frame describing time blocks related to SCF."
kableExtra::kbl(lstMFs$tblYS_TCF |> head(),booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
lstMFs$tblPDs_x      = tidyr::expand_grid(x=dim_x);
lstMFs$tblPDs_male   = lstMFs$tblPDs_x |> dplyr::filter(x=="M");
lstMFs$tblPDs_female = lstMFs$tblPDs_x |> dplyr::filter(x=="F");
```

```{r}
##--create table linking model frames with fixed effects, environmental covariates, and random effects for selectivity/retention parameters
str = paste0("
 pid   tid  param    MFs                                    FEs        ECs     REs        label
  1     1    z50     [tblYS_TCF;..tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_x]       ~0+tb:f    NA      NA         TCF_sel_z50
  2     1    width   [tblYS_TCF;..tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+x:f:tb  NA      NA         TCF_sel_width_males
  3     1    width   [tblYS_TCF;..tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_female]  ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         TCF_sel_width_females
  4     2  asc_width [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         sel_ascending_width_SCF_males
  5     2     mode   [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         sel_mode_width_SCF_males
  6     2  dsc_width [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         sel_descending_width_SCF_males
  7     3    z50     [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_female]  ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         sel_z50_SCF_females
  8     3    width   [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_female]  ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         sel_width_SCF_females
  9     4    z50     [tblYS_retZ1;tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         ret_z50_TCF_males
 10     4    width   [tblYS_retW1;tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         ret_width_TCF_males
 11     5    z50     [tblYS_retZ2;tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         ret_z50_TCF_males
-10     5    width   [tblYS_retW1;tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA      NA         ret_width_TCF_males_mirrored
")
tblSelPars = readr::read_csv(str |> whitespace_groups_to_commas(),progress=FALSE,show_col_types=FALSE);
cap = "tblSelPars, a model frame describing selectivity parameters."
kableExtra::kbl(tblSelPars,booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
```

```{r}
#--expand the parameters by the model frames
tblMFs = expandSelParamsMFs(tblSelPars,lstMFs);
lstExpMFs = list();
for (r in 1:nrow(tblMFs)){
  #--testing r = 1;
  cat("expanding row",r,"\n");
  rw = tblMFs[r,];
  ##--fixed effects
  lstFEs = list();
  if (!is.na(rw$FEs[1])){
    fFEs = formula(rw$FEs[1]);
    mfFEs = model.frame(fFEs,rw$mf[1][[1]]);  #--model frame
    mmFEs = gmacs.model.matrix(fFEs,rw$mf[1][[1]]); #--model matrix, but may be "expanded" for missing factors levels
    #--drop columns involving missing factor levels
    idxs = which(colSums(abs(mmFEs))>0);
    if (length(idxs)>0) mmFEs = mmFEs[,idxs,drop=FALSE];
    #--combine model frame and model matrix
    mfmFEs = dplyr::bind_cols(mfFEs,mmFEs);
    #--identify distinct combinations
    umfmFEs = dplyr::distinct(mfmFEs);
    #--create table
    lstFEs = list(fFEs=fFEs,mfFEs=mfFEs,mmFEs=mmFEs,umfmFEs=umfmFEs);
  }
  ##--environmental covariates
  lstECs = list();
  if (!is.na(rw$ECs[1])){
    fECs = formula(rw$ECs[1]);
    mfECs = model.frame(fECs,rw$mf[1][[1]]);  #--model frame
    mmECs = gmacs.model.matrix(fECs,rw$mf[1][[1]]); #--model matrix, but may be "expanded" for missing factors levels
    #--drop missing factor levels
    idxs = which(colSums(abs(mmECs))>0);
    if (length(idxs)>0) mmECs = mmECs[,idxs];
    #--combine model frame and model matrix
    mfmECs = dplyr::bind_cols(mfECs,mmECs);
    #--identify distinct combinations
    umfmECs = dplyr::distinct(mfmECs);
    #--create table
    lstECs = list(fECs=fECs,mfECs=mfECs,mmECs=mmECs,umfmECs=umfmECs);
  }
  ##--random effects
  lstREs = list();
  if (!is.na(rw$REs[1])){
    fREs = formula(paste0("~0+",rw$REs[1]));
    mfREs = model.frame(fREs,rw$mf[1][[1]]);  #--model frame
    mmREs = gmacs.model.matrix(fREs,rw$mf[1][[1]]); #--model matrix, but may be "expanded" for missing factors levels
    #--drop missing factor levels
    idxs = which(colSums(abs(mmREs))>0);
    if (length(idxs)>0) mmREs = mmREs[,idxs];
    #--combine model frame and model matrix
    mfmREs = dplyr::bind_cols(mfREs,mmREs);
    #--identify distinct combinations
    umfmREs = dplyr::distinct(mfmREs);
    #--create table
    lstREs = list(fREs=fREs,mfREs=mfREs,mmREs=mmREs,umfmREs=umfmREs);
  }
  lstExpMFs[[r]] = tibble::tibble(lstFEs=list(lstFEs=lstFEs),lstECs=list(lstECs=lstECs),lstREs=list(lstREs=lstREs));
}
##--create tibble with expanded model frames for each parameter
tblExpMFs = dplyr::bind_rows(lstExpMFs);
##--create tibble with expansion info for each parameter by appending `tblExpMFs` columnwise to `tblSelPars`
tblExpSelPars = dplyr::bind_cols(tblSelPars,tblExpMFs);
```

```{r}
tblSelParsValues_FEs = tblSelParsValues_FixedEffects(tblExpSelPars);
cap = "Table defining selectivity/retention parameter initial values, bounds, estimation phase, and prior probability characteristics."
kableExtra::kbl(tblSelParsValues_FEs,booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
```
